definitions.explanation: A condition in which the body's core temperature drops below the normal range. Can be caused by prolonged exposure to cold, certain medical conditions, or poor circulation. Also used colloquially for people who tend to have a naturally low body temperature.

examples.japanese: {低体温|ていたいおん}に{注意|ちゅうい}してください。
{冬山|ふゆやま}では{低体温|ていたいおん}{症|しょう}になる{危険|きけん}がある。
examples.english: There is a risk of hypothermia in the winter mountains.

examples.japanese: {体|からだ}が{冷|ひ}えて{低体温|ていたいおん}になると、{判断力|はんだんりょく}が{鈍|にぶ}り、{重大|じゅうだい}な{事故|じこ}につながることがある。
examples.english: When the body gets cold and hypothermia sets in, judgment becomes impaired, which can lead to serious accidents.

notes:
Composed of {低|てい} (low), {体|たい} (body), and {温|おん} (temperature). The full medical term is {低体温症|ていたいおんしょう} with the suffix {症|しょう} (condition/syndrome), but {低体温|ていたいおん} is commonly used on its own.

In everyday conversation, Japanese people sometimes describe themselves as {低体温|ていたいおん}{体質|たいしつ} (having a low-body-temperature constitution) — meaning they tend to run cold and feel chilly easily. This is distinct from clinical hypothermia.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {低体温|ていたいおん}{症|しょう}: hypothermia (medical term)
- {低体温|ていたいおん}になる: to become hypothermic
- {低体温|ていたいおん}{体質|たいしつ}: low-body-temperature constitution
- {低体温|ていたいおん}を{防|ふせ}ぐ: to prevent hypothermia

RELATED WORDS:
- {高体温|こうたいおん}: hyperthermia — abnormally high body temperature
- {体温|たいおん}: body temperature — the base term
- {凍傷|とうしょう}: frostbite — localized cold injury, distinct from whole-body hypothermia
